# SI013 — missing-canonicalization

The object passed to the equivalence helper must be canonicalized.

## Why

Canonicalization is the one place normalization can be audited. Comparing anything else invites silent divergence.

## Bad

```python
gl.eq_principle.strict_eq(lambda: json.loads(raw))
```

## Good

```python
gl.eq_principle.strict_eq(evaluate)  # evaluate -> _aggregate(...)
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI013 -- reason
```
